The recurrent and convolution tensors share one padded GDN Mamba page, so the
CUDA total counts their 117,964,800-byte allocation once. Byte counts are
deterministic; run-to-run variance does not apply.

**Verdict.** Accepted as the byte-counted allocation plan at TP2, MTP3, c16,
and 262144 tokens. The plan covers every pinned target, QSA, GDN, PLE, and MTP
state family per rank. Model-resident allocation, engine binding, and atomic
restore parity remain unproven.

**Next.**

- allocate every listed tensor inside one model-resident rank and record CUDA allocator deltas
- bind every allocation to the serving engine
- prove atomic evict and restore parity at one shared accepted-token boundary

**Reopen if.**

- NVIDIA publishes a checkpoint revision with different state geometry, or an upstream vLLM release changes QSA, Mamba, PLE, or MTP cache allocation semantics
